Logo and icons

New logo (the lombax mark and the name) in the header and on the welcome screen, as a sharp vector. It sits level with the bar's text, and only fades in once at start (it…

pullRequests.title: fix(rac1): hoverboard girl grows; list new differences
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: fix/rac1-hoverboard-girl
pullRequests.body:
Joint modifier scale was dropped on joints without a scale key, so the hoverboard girl never grew.
Differences from the original now list the pause-load guard and the remembered language and sound.

pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: docs/rac1-remembered-options
pullRequests.body:
Differences from the original now list the remembered language and Sound page.
The port keeps them between runs; a loaded save keeps the player's options.

pullRequests.title: fix(rac1): load from pause flight matches the console
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: fix/rac1-load-from-pause
pullRequests.body:
initialize_level_runtime wrote 0x100000 to D_00160000+0x100C, which the port moved to the wrong word in a level.
space.c now names D_0016100C, so the flight matches PCSX2 (0x100000, then 0xA0000) and the boot.c wrap is gone.

pullRequests.title: feat(launcher): import saves from PCSX2
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: feat/launcher-import-pcsx2
pullRequests.body:
The game's menu gets Import saves from PCSX2: it reads a .ps2 card file or a folder card.
The game's save folder is copied onto OpenRAC's card after a backup, and the saves list reloads.

pullRequests.author: mateuszklysz
pullRequests.head: fix/android-disc-setup
pullRequests.body:
Description
On Android a game set up from its disc could not be played, a .chd failed with no message, and a refused disc said only "Activity has what it printed". This fixes all three and adds Rebuild.
Changelog
Setting up from your disc

Errors from the disc picker (Set up from your disc, and Android's games folder) show as a toast instead of nothing.
A failed set-up shows the extractor's own reason, for example "The image is not a version of this game that OpenRAC knows (…)", in one toast…

pullRequests.title: fix(rac1): vendor icons after an in-level movie
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: fix/rac1-movie-parks-ram
pullRequests.body:
The movie's RAM park into GS memory covered the HUD textures, so vendor icons went blank.
The port's player never uses that RAM, so the park and the read-back now skip image transfers.

pullRequests.title: fix(probes): scenes bake without collision.glb
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: fix/probes-scenes-without-collision
pullRequests.body:
The title (99) and flight (98) scenes have no collision.glb, so their bake failed at the end.
They are now planned from their authored volumes, with no moby seeds or geometry coverage.

pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: feat/launcher-play-with-mods-tick
pullRequests.body:
Play brings the mods only with the Mods switch under it on (off by default); it replaces Play with mods and Purist mode.
The Mods tab is for adding and setting up mods; the 0.9.0 notes say so.

commits.headline: perf(probes): bake the largest levels first, each with every thread
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
With --jobs 0 the desktop gave each bake an equal share of the threads,
one each when a bake runs per thread, and baked the levels in folder
order: the largest level was left baking on one core long after the
others had finished, the rest of the CPU idle. Android already let every
baker take every thread and started the largest first; every platform
does now. --threads does not change a bake's bytes, so cached bakes stay
valid. Tests: the probe tools' suite.

config/us/overlays/asm/FUN_L10_002e8358.s). Orxon's magnetboots pickup
(platform.c) sets the same D_L10_0015F640 after its own message.
Translated, the…

commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
docs/SOURCES.md lists the edits OpenRAC makes to each imported tree, so
that a sync keeps them. It did not name games/rac1/ntsc/OPENRAC_PATCHES.md,
the record of the C patches the native NTSC-U port needs (screamer.c's
among them, from PR #49), so the list left out the largest set.

commits.headline: refactor(port): define the game option entry points in game_host.cpp
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
PR #49 defined openrac_game_option and openrac_game_set_option as
extern "C" in settings.cpp, with stubs in program/game_host.cpp for the
programs without a window. CODING_CONVENTIONS.md section 14.3 puts a C
contract's definitions in the file named for it: both now live in
game_host.cpp, each through c_boundary::call, and call the settings'
own C++ functions, settings::game_option and settings::set_game_option,
when the window is built in. settings.cpp no longer includes
c_boundary.h. main.cpp…

commits.headline: test(port): cover the game options in the settings file
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The game_* keys PR #49 added had no test. settings_test now checks that
they load from the file, that a value past the file's range or not a
number is refused (the fallback answers), that a set option is saved
and read back, and that setting an unchanged value leaves the file
alone, as the game sets its options every frame.

commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
move_old_data_home (PR #49) sits after data_home now, with a doc
comment that says what it does instead of a date, a comment on each
guard, and blank lines between its steps. data_home ran it through a
function-local static, a once-only flag CODING_CONVENTIONS.md 11.4
does not allow in new code; parse runs it instead, once, before it
fills in the default card or settings path, the only callers of
data_home. data_home's comment names the launcher's data_home, not
get_memcard_dir.

The same…

commits.headline: fix(port): say when the old Windows data folder cannot be renamed
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
After copying the old folder's cards and settings into %LOCALAPPDATA%,
move_old_data_home renamed the old folder without checking the result
and logged that the files were now in the new folder either way.
CODING_CONVENTIONS.md 13.6 wants every file operation checked. A
rename that fails is now a warning naming both folders and the reason,
and the info line is only logged after a rename that worked. Nothing
else changes: the folder is still copied again at the next start,
without replacing the…

commits.headline: refactor(launcher): test the Windows data folder
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
PR #49 taught data_home Windows' %LOCALAPPDATA%\openrac, with the
user's profile as the fallback, inside a cfg!(windows) branch that no
test reached on the machines that run them. The choice is now
windows_data_home(local_app_data, profile), a function of its inputs
that data_home calls, and two tests hold it to the port's data_home:
LOCALAPPDATA when set, the profile's AppData\Local when it is unset or
empty, nothing with neither.

The doc comment names the port's data_home where it is…

commits.headline: refactor(port): test which undrawn ticks keep the last picture
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
PR #49's vsync change keeps the window's last picture on a level's tick
on which the game drew nothing after a drawn one, at most two in a row
(the flash when Start skipped a landing). The rule lived in two
function-local statics in vsync() and had no test. It is now
program::UndrawnTicks (game/common/program/undrawn_ticks.h), with the
two in a row named kMostUndrawnTicks, and undrawn_ticks_test checks it:
kept after a drawn tick, at most twice, counted again after a drawn
one; never before the…

commits.headline: refactor(port): close the sound once when the Android window closes
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
PR #49 made leave() close the sound before anything else, on every
platform, so the window's end (SDL_Quit) no longer frees the stream
under it. The Android branch still closed it again after finish();
close_sound only resets an owner that is already empty by then. The
second call is gone.

commits.headline: refactor(port): name the numbers in PR #49's image and folded-copy checks
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
frame.cpp's sends_image walked the 2D path's packets with 16, 8 and 3

the value in its low 8 bytes and the register's address after them)
and TRXDIR's XDIR field read with gs::bits against kHostToLocal, as
direct.cpp reads it, with a comment on the loop and the match.

guest.cpp's new warning in openrac_folded_address prints its addresses
at their width ({:#010x}, as the file's other address messages do).
The check itself is…

initialize_level_runtime's wrapper reads the display list's size and
compares it with the pause menu's largest, now DISPLAY_LIST_SIZE and
PAUSE_LIST_SIZE with their source, in…

commits.headline: refactor(rac1): name the Sound page's words in options.c
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The options PR #49 remembers between runs read and wrote the Sound
page as SOUND + 4u * i for i below 3, held its volumes to 0x400, kept

LOUDEST and GAME_LANGUAGES now, with a source for each, a comment on
each control block, and the language and the page kept apart in
memcard_RestoreGame's wrapper. The file comment says it holds the
remembered options…

commits.headline: fix: the build and the lighting bake leave the computer usable
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The launcher's bake ran one level per CPU thread at once (--jobs 0), each
baker told to use every thread and each Embree device starting its own pool
of every thread, all at normal priority: on a 16-core 5950X, all 21 levels
with hundreds of busy threads, the desktop barely responding. The build
compiled with Ninja's default of every thread plus two.

- openrac_common.background: lower_priority() puts a tool and the programs
  it starts below normal priority (Windows' class is inherited; POSIX…

commits.author: Veradictus

Progress: the baker prints "Probes DONE/TOTAL" for its level as it traces;
bake_all weighs each level by its export and prints "Lighting 42.5% (about

The bar used to move only when a whole level finished, seven at once.

Going on after a stop: a level's unfinished folder (.level_NN.partial) is
kept with the stamp of what it was made from; the next bake with the same
inputs runs the baker with --resume, which reads back…

commits.headline: fix(probes): a level with nothing to bake is done, not failed
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
Level 98, the flight between planets, is only a sky: the baker stopped with
"no static render geometry to bake", so every bake ended 20/21 with it as a
failure and the launcher never showed the lighting as ready for all levels.
The baker now exits with its own status (3, kNothingToBake) for such a
level; bake_level records it as done with no bake (bake-result.json
"empty"), bake_all keeps it as up to date afterwards, and the launcher's
status counts it as ready. The game keeps that level's own…

commits.headline: fix(port): drop a prepared tick that an undrawn tick left behind
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
With the Vulkan render worker, vsync prepares the next tick's camera and
mobys while the last frame records. On an undrawn tick (program/
undrawn_ticks.h) frame() never runs, so that preparation stayed in the
slot, and the next vsync, with no frame in flight, prepared nothing and
left it there: frame() then drew the earlier tick's mobys. On Kerwan the
galactic map's first frame drew all 953 level mobys instead of the
map's 13 and came out a flat dark frame, a pop the synchronous…

commits.headline: fix(port): a level's tick without a world keeps the last picture under its 2D
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
On the console a tick that draws no world leaves the displayed frame
buffer as it was, and the 2D it draws goes over it. The port cleared
such ticks to the level's background colour, or held the last world for
at most three ticks:

- Pokitaru's vendor darkens the screen a quarter a tick for four ticks
  while the world stops; the fourth was cleared to the level's cyan, a
  full-screen flash every time the vendor opened, and the darkening
  never added up.

commits.headline: fix(enhanced): scale the sun cascades' bias and normal offset with their texels
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The sun shadow's normal offset (0.025) and depth bias (0.01) were fixed
in world units for all four cascades. The nearest cascade's texels are
about 0.012 units, the farthest's about 0.3 over the 256-unit range, so
a distant receiver steeper to the light than the filter's slope clamp
compared against its own stored depth and shadowed itself: speckles and
stair-stepped dark fringes on distant hills, cliffs and foliage, while
near shadows were clean.

Both now follow the sampled cascade's texel…

commits.headline: fix(launcher): Android disc set-up works again, says why it fails, and offers Rebuild (#58)
commits.author: mateuszklysz
commits.body:
* fix(launcher): say why a disc could not be set up, and unpack any CHD on Android

Setting a game up from its disc failed silently on Android: the picker's
errors were never shown, and a failed set-up said only "Activity has what
it printed", so a CHD that could not be read looked like nothing at all.

- Both pickers (Set up from your disc, and Android's games folder) show
  the error as a toast, and a failed set-up toasts the extractor's own
  reason ("the image is not a version of this game…

commits.headline: fix(scene): moby glow faces write depth above the GS's alpha reference
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The GS draws every moby face with TEST 0x5360b: a fragment whose alpha
reaches 0x60 writes Z, the others colour only. The port drew the glow
faces (MobyProc's glow list, mode bit 0x10) in one blended draw that
wrote no depth, and draws mobys without face culling, so a far glow face
was never hidden by a near one. The parked ship on Pokitaru, after an
ordinary landing, has its glow bit set: seen from behind, its front
thrusters' hatched glow showed through the rear thrusters' light bars,
as if…

commits.headline: test(scene): count the second moby glow draw on OpenGL in the viewer test
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
db1900cf draws the mobys' glow pass in two draws; the viewer test's OpenGL and ES expectations after the PVS checks still counted one (4 where the moby now submits 5), and the port-enhanced CI job's GL run failed at viewer_test.cpp lines 464 and 480. Vulkan's counts there (2: the moby is culled) are unchanged.

Checked: viewer_vulkan passes on the Mac; the Mac has no OpenGL 4.1 core context for the GL and ES variants, so those run in CI.
